A generated front door. Every figure below is derived from the repository's own metadata;

## The object

The figure-eight knot complement **m004** -- the unique arithmetic knot complement, trace
field `Q(sqrt-3)`. The programme asks what such an object forces, and reports that it forces
**form** while refusing **values**. Most results are therefore negatives, and that is the
result, not the debt.

L173: THE EXPERIMENTAL KNOB ALREADY ON THE APPARATUS IS OUR INTERCEPT. Websearch lane 2. The photonic and cold-atom quasicrystal programmes adiabatically vary the PHASON -- 'the relative phase between the modulation and the underlying lattice' -- and pump states across the sample. THAT PHASE IS THE STURMIAN INTERCEPT: B8091 showed the founding rule forces the SLOPE (golden) and never supplies the INTERCEPT, the circle-torsor the object leaves free, and the experimental community's standard control parameter is precisely that free coordinate -- so the banked prediction shape (the FUNCTION rho -> edge content) is falsifiable with apparatus that already exists. ANCHORS: Verbin-Zilberberg-Kraus-Lahini-Silberberg arXiv:1403.7124 / PRB 91 064201 (photonic waveguide array, family interpolating Fibonacci<->Harper, introduced precisely because the Fibonacci QC has NO native pumping parameter); the off-diagonal Harper waveguide work; Nature 553 59 (2018) for 2D-quasiperiodic-as-4D-quantum-Hall boundary pumping; the cold-atom Aubry-Andre-Harper programme with tunable modulation phase and real-space edge-mode detection; and gap labeling with Chern numbers incl. third Chern numbers in 3D quasicrystals (arXiv:2201.04820). THE DISCIPLINE, STATED BEFORE ANYONE GETS EXCITED: gap labeling is standard, mature and already measured, so a prediction of the form 'N edge modes at intercept rho' is NOT automatically novel -- if it coincides with what the gap-labeling theorem already forces it is a RE-DERIVATION, not a prediction. The prereg must state what gap labeling predicts for the same configuration and where our claim DIFFERS, before any comparison; this is B724's look-elsewhere discipline transposed to an experimental lane and is the most likely route to a false positive here. WHAT THE PREREG CAN NOW SAY: any group with a photonic waveguide array or a cold-atom AAH chain that can scan the phason -- standard practice, not a bespoke request -- can falsify the FUNCTION, not a point. NOT ESTABLISHED: precision figures were not extracted (abstracts do not carry them; full texts not obtained), so no required resolution can yet be stated; and novelty against gap labeling was NOT verified, so this lane currently has an anchor list and NO established novelty. THEIR CONSTRUCTION: the crossed product of the static patch's Type III_1 algebra by the one-parameter automorphism group generated by H, the modular/boost generator, giving Type II_infinity; an observer is FORCED because 'the modular automorphism group acts ergodically', so the only H-invariant elements are c-numbers; the observer is a clock with H_obs = q AND q >= 0, and that POSITIVITY is exactly what converts II_infinity to II_1 via the projection Pi = Theta(q), since Tr 1 = 1 is finite; the maximum-entropy state has density matrix rho_max = 1 with flat entanglement spectrum. THE TYPING against cc's three binding criteria: (a) DISANALOGY, structural -- their engine is that the modular flow acts ERGODICALLY, which is why an observer is needed at all, whereas B721's tracial state has TRIVIAL modular flow (a state is tracial iff its modular group is trivial), so on our side everything is invariant and nothing forces an observer; the crossed product by a trivial flow is just A tensor L-infinity(R), not their construction -- this is the OPPOSITE hypothesis at the load-bearing step; (b) UNRESOLVED and the decisive test -- a MATCH requires B1040's battery to carry a positivity constraint doing the same II_infinity-to-II_1 work, which is an in-sandbox question about our own arc, registered as owed not asserted; (c) NEAR-VACUOUS -- rho_max = 1 with flat spectrum is the canonical feature of ANY II_1 factor, and cc's own trap warning applies at full strength since the hyperfinite II_1 factor is UNIQUE, as CLPW themselves note. VERDICT: MOOD, banked as consistent-not-distinctive. BUT THE DISANALOGY IS WORTH MORE THAN A WEAK MATCH: if our modular flow is genuinely trivial we are at their ENDPOINT without their construction, since a tracial state IS a finite algebra with a trace; the question inverts to why our object already has what theirs must build, and sharply to whether triviality of our modular flow is a DERIVED fact or a MODELLING CHOICE -- if chosen, that is where the analogy was smuggled in. ## How to falsify any of this

1. Every closure names an **escape hatch** -- the computation that would reopen it. Pick a
   door in `CLOSED_DOORS.md`, run its hatch; the door holds or it does not.
2. Every PROVED arc names its **test locks**. Run them.
3. The gates (`python3 scripts/gates/gates.py`) enforce the governance invariants, and each
   was verified by deliberate breakage -- a gate never observed to fail is not a gate.

You do not need to read the record to check the programme. That is the point of this page.
